_comment: Reference mem0.json for the Cursor-OpenAI gateway integration. Copy to Hermes' home folder (the folder printed by `hermes config path`) as mem0.json, then adjust: user_id (your canonical identity across all chat platforms), the gateway port if you changed it, and the vector store path (any writable local folder; <hermes home>/mem0_qdrant recommended). embedding_dims MUST match the embedder model (nomic-embed-text = 768) in BOTH places it appears. Embedded path mode is single-process; if you run several Hermes processes (gateway + dashboard + CLI), replace the vector_store 'path' line with 'url': 'http://127.0.0.1:6333' and run a Qdrant server (see README, Storage modes). Remove this _comment key - Hermes tolerates it, but keep the file minimal.
